polaris: 在 amorphous In2O3 透明导电氧化物中，带状输运的充分判据究竟是 Anderson/Mott mobility-edge 填充，还是 In-s 中程连通网络与 O-O/配位缺陷阈值？
framework: Anderson/Mott mobility-edge + Drude/Ioffe-Regel consistency test, converted in Round 2 into a same-sample falsification table against structural connectivity metrics.
findings: Round 2 修复 A Round 1 的落地阻断：A 不再只指出 same-sample k_F*l vs In-s/结构连通阈值的空白，而给出两个可执行 artifact。Artifact A1 用 Furubayashi 2019 的 a-ITO 厚度序列重分析 Hall n/mu 与结构量，把 k_F*l、E_F 和厚度/密度/界面粗糙等同样品列放进一张表；这是现有实验数据的最低可执行落地。Artifact A2 用 Jankousky 2025/2026 的 1500 个 40-atom a-In2O3 random structures 和 100 个 QSGW subset，把每个结构的 O-O bond、In coordination、edge/corner-sharing proxy、spectral linewidth、IPR、mobility 组成同一行；这是能真正检验 A-vs-B 的计算蓝图。A 的可证伪判据也被明确化：若在 matched carrier density 或 matched E_F-E_c 后，网络/O-O/配位指标仍独立预测 mu、spectral linewidth 或 IPR，而 k_F*l/E_F-E_c 不再显著，A 输。
weakest_link: Hall mobility = Drude mobility 仍是最高杠杆假设；必须用 Hall factor 与 optical/THz Drude mobility 检查。如果 r_H = mu_H/mu_D 显著偏离 1，Round 1 的 tau、l、k_F*l 全部按 1/r_H 重新标定。

landing_artifacts.purpose: 用现有 a-ITO 实验图表生成可执行表，检验 mobility-edge/Ioffe-Regel 指标是否比同样品结构/几何指标更能解释 mobility collapse。

derived from t_nm, density_g_cm3, roughness_nm, and any text assignment of ultrathin-limit disorder
extraction_table_schema.definition: z-score composite: low density, high roughness, and smaller t_nm imply larger disorder/connectivity penalty

extraction_table_schema.source: computed from mu_H with Hall factor set to 1

default_parameters.m_star: 0.2*m0 unless source-specific optical/effective-mass value is extracted
default_parameters.r_H: 1 for first pass; sweep 0.5, 1, 2 as sensitivity check

judgment_rules: A passes this artifact only weakly if samples with kF_l > 2 and matched high E_F_eV are metallic/high-mu regardless of structural_proxy.
A is ambiguous if mobility collapse occurs only near kF_l about 1, because mobility-edge and structural disorder can both explain the boundary.
A loses on this artifact if, after matching n_H or E_F_eV bins, structural_proxy predicts mu_H or l_reported_nm with monotonic residual trend while kF_l adds no predictive power.
Do not claim a decisive B failure from A1 alone because it uses structural proxies rather than direct In-s graph connectivity.

landing_artifacts.purpose: 在同一批 atomistic structures 上同时计算 A 指标与结构网络指标，直接消除 Round 1 的 same-sample 空白。

data_source.label: Jankousky et al. 2025/2026
data_source.title: Effective bands and band-like electron transport in amorphous solids
usable_items: 1500 random 40-atom a-In2O3 structures relaxed at PBE
Fig. 1 spectral functions / effective conduction band
Fig. 2 O-O bond split and mobility trend
SI Fig. S7/S8 IPR with/without O-O bonds
SI Fig. S9 correlation of total energy, CBM, In coordination
data_source.sample_axis: one relaxed 40-atom structure per row; QSGW rows get spectral/IPR/mobility columns, PBE-only rows get structural/network columns

extraction_table_schema.source: PBE total energy relative to lowest structure
In-O coordination count using first minimum of g_InO(r)
In-In peak assignment near 3.4 Angstrom edge-sharing and 3.7-3.8 Angstrom corner-sharing
graph with In nodes and edge weight exp(-r_InIn/lambda_s); threshold theta chosen from crystalline bixbyite nearest-neighbor distribution
QSGW aligned spectra, or PBE proxy for non-QSGW rows
SI S7/S8 wavefunction IPR for CBM

threshold_definitions.O_O_bond_cutoff: 1.7 Angstrom; motivated by O-O peak near 1.5 Angstrom in Jankousky/Aliano-style a-In2O3 structural analysis; sensitivity sweep 1.6-1.8 Angstrom
threshold_definitions.In_O_coordination_cutoff: first minimum of g_InO(r) for the same ensemble; do not hard-code if raw PDF is available
threshold_definitions.In_s_graph_edge: weighted edge w=exp(-r_InIn/lambda_s); lambda_s calibrated so bixbyite first/second In-In shells remain connected; theta swept and reported rather than fitted to mu

judgment_rules: A wins if, after controlling for n or E_F-E_c, mu_Drude_calc and IPR_CBM are explained by linewidth/E_F/kF_l and structural graph variables lose significance or only enter through DeltaE.
A loses if has_OO_bond, frac_In_6fold, largest_In_s_component_size, or lambda2_graph_laplacian predict linewidth_DeltaE_eV, mu_Drude_calc, or IPR_CBM within matched E_F-E_c bins.
A/B integration result if graph variables predict DeltaE but not residual transport after DeltaE: mobility edge is the observable projection of the In-s graph, not an independent sufficient cause.
minimal_code_blueprint: load relaxed structures as pymatgen Structure objects
compute O-O counts, In-O coordination, In-In shells
build weighted In graph and compute largest component plus Laplacian lambda2 with networkx
join QSGW spectral rows by structure_id
fit nested models: mu/IPR ~ E_F-E_c + kF_l versus mu/IPR ~ E_F-E_c + kF_l + graph_metrics
report AIC/BIC/cross-validated R2 and residual monotonicity within matched E_F-E_c bins

hall_factor_and_optical_drude_checks.problem_statement: Round 1 treated Hall mobility as Drude mobility. In general mu_H = r_H*mu_D, and Hall carrier density n_H = n/r_H for a single carrier type. Therefore k_F, tau, l and k_F*l must be sensitivity-tested against r_H and, where possible, replaced by optical/THz Drude parameters.

check_paths.action: For each experimental sample, record whether the source reports Hall factor, multiband correction, or scattering model. If absent, sweep r_H = 0.5, 1, 2.
check_paths.impact: k_F scales as r_H**(1/3), tau scales as 1/r_H, and k_F*l approximately scales as r_H**(-1/3) at fixed mu_H,n_H,m_star.

check_paths.action: Use IR/THz ellipsometry or Drude-Smith fits where available. Extract plasma frequency omega_p and scattering rate gamma.
check_paths.comparison_rule: If abs(log10(mu_opt/mu_H)) <= 0.2 dex, Hall=Drude is acceptable for k_F*l classification. If mismatch exceeds 0.3 dex, use optical tau for l and treat Hall-only k_F*l as assumption-level.

check_paths.action: If optical data are fitted by Drude-Smith rather than simple Drude, extract c parameter.
check_paths.comparison_rule: Strong negative c, e.g. c < -0.5, means Hall mobility can overstate a clean Drude mean free path; classify A's k_F*l as non-independent consistency estimate.

check_paths.action: Prefer papers/samples that report Hall n/mu and optical Drude or THz conductivity on the same film.
candidate_sources_from_mcp: Furubayashi 2019 for Hall transport in a-ITO
Sahoo/Au/Pan 2024 ITO THz Drude-Smith as method precedent, DOI 10.3390/coatings14070895
ITO/ENZ ellipsometry papers as optical-Drude method precedents when a-In2O3 same-sample optical data are absent

falsification_criteria_for_A.primary_rule: A loses if, in matched carrier density or matched E_F-E_c subsets, structural network metrics still predict mu, spectral linewidth, or IPR with significant residual power after k_F*l/E_F-E_c are included.
matched_density_protocol: bin or match samples by n_true within +/-0.1 dex after Hall-factor correction
within each bin compare residual mu_D, linewidth_DeltaE, and IPR_CBM against graph metrics
use nested regression or paired ranking; require graph residual effect to be monotonic and not driven by one outlier
matched_EF_protocol: compute E_F-E_c from optical/effective-band data where possible; otherwise use parabolic E_F_eV consistently
test whether has_OO_bond, frac_In_6fold, largest component fraction, or lambda2 still predicts localization/IPR/mobility
falsification_criteria_for_A.A_win_condition: At matched n or E_F-E_c, k_F*l/linewidth explains transport and graph metrics have no independent residual predictive power except through their effect on DeltaE or Ec.
falsification_criteria_for_A.A_loss_condition: At matched n or E_F-E_c, graph metrics predict mu or IPR while k_F*l is held fixed or loses significance.
falsification_criteria_for_A.ambiguous_condition: Graph metrics only predict DeltaE, and DeltaE predicts transport; then the correct synthesis is not strong A but 'mobility edge as projection of structural graph'.

claims.statement: A Round 2 的最小可落地产物是 Furubayashi 2019 thickness-series CSV：每个厚度样品提取 n_H、mu_H、rho、XRR结构量，并计算 k_F、tau、l、k_F*l、E_F；这可立即测试 Hall/Drude mobility-edge 指标是否独立于结构/厚度 proxy 解释 mobility collapse。

variables.n_m3: carrier density in m**-3 after Hall-factor correction

limits.desc: zero carrier density gives zero Fermi wavevector

assumptions: Furubayashi thickness series is treated as comparable same-study samples, not identical atomistic structures.
Structural connectivity is proxied by thickness/XRR density/roughness unless direct pair distribution data are available.
Hall factor is swept rather than assumed fixed.

claims.statement: A 的强判据现在可证伪：在 Jankousky 结构集合中，若 matched n 或 matched E_F-E_c 后 O-O bond、In coordination 或 In-s graph connectivity 仍预测 mu/IPR/linewidth，则 A 的 'mobility-edge first and sufficient' 版本失败。

variables.L_weighted: weighted graph Laplacian of In-s connectivity graph

assumptions: The 40-atom local-environment ensemble is a valid same-sample surrogate for amorphous microstates.
Graph thresholds are predeclared and sensitivity-swept, not fitted to the mobility target.
Matched E_F-E_c can be constructed from aligned QSGW spectra.

claims.statement: Hall mobility cannot be silently equated to Drude mobility; the correct Round 2 table must carry r_H and optical/THz Drude checks, otherwise k_F*l remains a plausibility diagnostic rather than an independent proof.

references.label: Sahoo, Au, Pan 2024 THz Drude-Smith ITO method precedent

assumptions: Optical Drude data may not exist for every a-In2O3 same sample; if absent, r_H sensitivity is mandatory.
Drude-Smith backscattering parameter c must be reported if the optical fit is not simple Drude.

INSPECTOR_CHECK.formula: Furubayashi artifact: k_F=(3*pi**2*n_m3)**(1/3), tau=mu_H*m_star/(e*r_H), l=(hbar*k_F/m_star)*tau, kF_l=k_F*l, E_F=hbar**2*k_F**2/(2*m_star*e). Jankousky artifact: tau_linewidth=hbar/(2*DeltaE_J), mu=e*tau_linewidth/m_star, graph metrics from predeclared In-In/O-O/coordination cutoffs.
INSPECTOR_CHECK.direction: If same-sample mobility/IPR is controlled by kF_l or linewidth after matching n/E_F-E_c, A survives; if network/O-O/coordination metrics retain independent residual power, A fails.
INSPECTOR_CHECK.data: Furubayashi et al. 2019 DOI 10.1186/s11671-019-2948-4 Table 1/Fig. 4/Fig. 5/Fig. 7; Jankousky et al. 2025/2026 DOI 10.1038/s41567-025-03099-x and arXiv:2505.07707 Fig. 1/Fig. 2/SI S7/S8/S9; optical Drude method precedent DOI 10.3390/coatings14070895.
INSPECTOR_CHECK.assumptions: m*=0.2m0 first pass; Hall factor r_H swept or replaced by optical Drude; structural graph thresholds predeclared; no B Round 2 output used.

deepening.deepening_1_consequence_layer_1: 若 A2 表显示 graph metrics 只通过 DeltaE/linewidth 影响 mobility，则 LP29 的更准确表述不是 A 压倒 B，而是 mobility edge 是结构网络扰动的谱投影。
deepening.deepening_1_consequence_layer_2: 再下一层后果是实验上无需寻找单独的 In-s percolation 临界点；只要测到 optical linewidth、E_F-E_c 与 Hall/THz mobility 的一致漂移，就可把结构效应折叠进 A 的 mobility-edge 参数。
deepening.deepening_2_weak_premise_layer_1: 最可能错的前提仍是单带 Hall/Drude 映射；r_H、多带与 Drude-Smith backscattering 会系统改写 tau 和 mean free path。
deepening.deepening_2_weak_premise_layer_2: 若 optical tau 与 Hall tau 不一致，k_F*l 不再能作为判据核心，A 必须退化为 spectral linewidth/mobility-edge 判据，而不是 Hall-derived Ioffe-Regel 判据。

next_plan: 下一轮不再增加概念推导，直接产出 A1 或 A2 的首版 CSV。优先 A1：数字化 Furubayashi 2019 Table 1/Fig. 4/Fig. 7，填入 n_H、mu_H、rho、t_nm、XRR structural columns 与 k_F*l(r_H=0.5/1/2)。若可获得 Jankousky raw structures/QSGW subset，则并行启动 A2 结构-谱 join 表。
